notes.title: AI Correction
notes.content: We have corrected several errors with the AI and have placed several signs to follow the correct path.

notes.title: Update notes for 20 April
notes.content:
We have fixed small bugs and we have improved the translations in some languages, and will soon improve the rest.
Thank you.

notes.title: IT'S TIME TO FACE DEVADATTA
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111187/174818ffb8c13f84b3ade6189c6da4409524690f.png[/img]

The release of Road to Devadatta has finally arrived.
We are very proud of our first release on Steam, and we hope you enjoy it and are satisfied with the experience.
It has been more than a year of work, but we think you will like the result.
Enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43111187/9520766126db63f8ca2d38481d5b65a04555e7de.png[/img]
